sloka: यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया ।सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे ।। ६.१०१.५२ ।।
transliteration: yadarthaṁ vānaraṁ sainyaṁ samānītamidaṁ mayā ।sugrīvaśca kṛto rājye nihatvā vālinaṁ raṇe ।। 6.101.52 ।।

translations.english: 'My glance has fallen upon Ravana as the glance of a serpent whose very look is venom — like a snake fallen under the gaze of Vinata's son, he cannot escape.'
